messages.傲慢スキルのクリティカル的中で呼吸を伸ばしつつ、呼吸と充電を相互に稼ぐ、傲慢斬撃: A multi-target Pride Slash E.G.O that extends Poise through Critical Hits with Pride skills while earning Poise and Charge from each other.
messages.呼吸の獲得: 攻撃前に呼吸4を得る。解析Ⅲから、的中した対象のうち死亡した数だけ: **Gaining Poise**: Gains 4 Poise before attacking. From Threadspin Ⅲ, gains 2 more Poise for each target hit that died.
messages.充電の獲得: 的中時に充電回数が2増え、クリティカル的中時にさらに自分の充電回数: **Gaining Charge**: Charge Count increases by 2 on hit, and her own Charge Count increases by 2 more on Critical Hit.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 充電回数を2ずつ消耗して呼吸1を得る(最大10)。解析Ⅳでは呼吸1: **Corrosion skill**: Spends 2 Charge Count at a time to gain 1 Poise, up to 10. At Threadspin Ⅳ, a Critical Hit with 10 or more Poise gains +30% Critical damage.
messages.パッシブ「夢を貪る」: 傲慢属性のスキルでクリティカル的中するたび、呼吸回数が1: **Passive — Dream Devouring**: Each Critical Hit with a Pride skill increases Poise Count by 1, up to 3 times per turn. Active from the turn after use until the end of the battle.
messages.広域化: 攻撃加重値が解析Ⅲで2、解析Ⅳで3になり、複数の敵に当てて呼吸を稼ぎや: **Multi-target**: Attack Weight becomes 2 at Threadspin Ⅲ and 3 at Ⅳ, making it easier to hit several enemies and earn Poise.
messages.呼吸を主軸にする人格の編成で、呼吸の補充と、傲慢スキルのクリティカルを狙う手段と: In teams built around Poise Identities, slot it in to top up Poise and to aim for Critical Hits with Pride skills.
messages.撃破が絡むと呼吸の伸びが大きいので、複数体に当てられる場面で使う。: Poise grows a lot when kills are involved, so use it when it can hit multiple enemies.
messages.火力・充電・呼吸のどれも控えめなので、呼吸と充電の両方を扱う編成でないと持ち味が: Its damage, Charge, and Poise are all modest, so it likely struggles to shine outside teams that use both Poise and Charge.
messages.必要資源は憂鬱2・傲慢2・嫉妬2。: It requires 2 Gloom, 2 Pride, and 2 Envy.
messages.Ⅲ: 攻撃加重値が2になり、撃破時の呼吸が加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Attack Weight becomes 2, and Poise on kills is added.
messages.Ⅳ: 攻撃加重値が3になり、侵蝕スキルにクリティカルダメージ増加が付く。: **Ⅳ**: Attack Weight becomes 3, and the Corrosion skill gains the Critical damage increase.
messages.エドガー家 チーフバトラー: 傲慢のS2は戦闘開始時に呼吸回数を消耗して攻撃加重: **[Edgar Family Chief Butler](persona:0408)**: Her Pride S2 spends Poise Count at Combat Start to increase Attack Weight, and Critical Hits with Pride skills make the passive easy to trigger.
messages.蜘蛛の巣の刀: S2(傲慢)が的中時に呼吸を得て、パッシブ「残像反響」でクリティ: **[Blade of the House of Spiders](persona:0415)**: Her S2 (Pride) gains Poise on hit, and the passive Afterimage Reverberation boosts Critical Hits. She also supplies Pride resources.
